title.narrative: Lifting Education Access and Resilience in times of Need in Ukraine Program

description.narrative: The development objective of the Lifting Education Access and Resilience in Times of Need in Ukraine Program is to (i) improve teaching and learning conditions; and (ii) strengthen management capacity of the education system. This paper seeks the approval of AF in the amount of 31.1 million US dollars (a grant of US$30 million from URTF and a grant of US$1.1 million from the GPE). The AF contributes to achieving the LEARN PDO “enhancing teaching and learning conditions and strengthening management capacities in the education sector” with a focus on ECPE. By supporting MoES and hromadas to plan, allocate, and monitor resources for ECPE and priority SAP areas, the AF reinforces the Project's objective of strengthening institutional capacity for effective education sector management and will introduce new activities and adjust existing ones to support ECPE related reforms and increased investment in sector capacity building. The Operation will also be restructured concurrently, to (i) update the results framework (RF) to reflect the new ECPE results; and (ii) extend the closing date from September 1, 2027 to December 31, 2028 to complete the new activities proposed under this AF. There are no changes to the PDO, PDO indicators, the PforR component of the original Program, the overall risk rating, implementation and/or fiduciary arrangements, or program action plan (PAP).
